{{Quote|Can't we turn the air-con down? Isn't anyone else cold?|Hrthek Val Voz, to the other delegates at the conference on Gus Talon|<ref name="Power Down">{{TCWComicCite|6.45|Power Down}}</ref>}}
[[Chief Liaison]] '''Hrthek Val Voz''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] negotiator who lived around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following a rise in [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] activity on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Gus Talon/Legends|Gus Talon]], Val Voz attended a peace [[Conference on Gus Talon|conference]] that was held within an automated [[Gus Talon diplomatic complex|facility]] on the world to discuss possible courses of action to counter the Separatist threat. During the event, Val Voz complained that he found the room to be cold.
